scenes_chirho.alt_chirho: A man in an ivory robe sounds a long silver trumpet as smiling adults and children gather among woven tents. A work tool and basket rest beside a tent, with sunlit hills beyond, all painted in warm, textured watercolor.
scenes_chirho.reading_note_chirho: The trumpet and gathered community imagine the holy assembly and day of trumpet blasts commanded in the verse. The unused tool and basket suggest ordinary labor set aside. The people, tents, landscape and trumpet design are illustrative choices, not details supplied by the verse; the first day of the seventh month is conveyed by the Scripture rather than a visual date.
